title: The 10 Best Coffee Makers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for coffee makers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at coffee makers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bonavita BV1901TS 8-Cup One-Touch Coffee Brewer
products.blurb: Key specs: SCA-certified brew temperature of 198 to 205 degrees, Pre-infusion bloom mode for even saturation, 8-cup stainless steel thermal carafe.
strengths: Bloom mode wets grounds evenly before extraction, a step almost no other machine in this range includes
Thermal carafe avoids the burnt, stale taste a hot plate produces after 20 minutes
Flat-bottom showerhead distributes water more evenly than the cone filters most competitors use
limitations: No programmable timer, must be started by hand every time
No digital display or brew-strength adjustment
8-cup capacity is limiting for larger households
features: SCA-certified brew temperature of 198 to 205 degrees
Pre-infusion bloom mode for even saturation

products.name: Cuisinart DCC-3200P1 PerfecTemp 14-Cup Programmable
products.blurb: Key specs: 192 to 196 degree PerfecTemp brewing system, 14-cup glass carafe capacity, 24-hour programmable timer.
strengths: 14-cup capacity is the largest in this guide, suited to bigger households
192 to 196 degree brew temperature beats most machines in this price tier, even if below the SCA minimum
Programmable timer and adjustable warming plate add flexibility budget machines skip
limitations: Brews below the 195-degree SCA minimum, so extraction is not as complete as the Bonavita's
Glass carafe on a hot plate continues cooking coffee, degrading flavor after 20 minutes
Bulkier footprint than the smaller 8 to 12-cup machines here
features: Adjustable warming plate with 4 heat settings

products.name: Ninja CE251 Programmable 12-Cup Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Flat-bottom filter basket for even extraction, 12-cup glass carafe, Rich and Classic brew strength settings.
strengths: Flat-bottom filter design distributes water more evenly than the cone filters on most competitors
Rich brew setting genuinely produces a bolder cup, not just a marketing label
limitations: Does not publish a specific brew temperature or carry SCA certification
Glass carafe and hot plate degrade coffee flavor after 20 to 30 minutes
Plastic housing feels less durable than metal-bodied competitors
features: Flat-bottom filter basket for even extraction
Rich and Classic brew strength settings

products.name: Hamilton Beach 49350 2-Way Brewer 12-Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup carafe side plus single-serve side, Compatible with any K-Cup or reusable filter pod, Independent operation of each brewing side.
strengths: Genuinely useful dual-function design for households with mixed single-cup and full-pot needs
Single-serve side accepts any K-Cup or a reusable filter, unlike brand-locked machines
limitations: Neither side publishes a specific brew temperature
Single-serve side lacks strength or temperature adjustment
Build quality feels noticeably more plastic than the single-purpose Bonavita or Cuisinart machines
features: Compatible with any K-Cup or reusable filter pod
Independent operation of each brewing side

products.name: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Coffee Maker BVMC-SJX33GT
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup glass carafe, Simple one-button brew start, Pause-and-serve function.
strengths: Pause n Serve lets you pour a cup mid-brew without dripping on the hot plate
Dead-simple one-button operation with nothing to configure or break
limitations: Brews at 185 to 192 degrees, well below the SCA-recommended range, producing under-extracted coffee
No programmable timer or brew-strength adjustment
Glass carafe on a hot plate cooks coffee further the longer it sits

products.name: Cuisinart DTC-975BKN 12-Cup Automatic Thermal Coffeemaker
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup double-wall stainless thermal carafe, Fully automatic brewing with 24-hour programmability, Gold-tone commercial style permanent filter.
strengths: Double-wall stainless carafe holds heat significantly longer than the single-wall BLACK+DECKER carafe
Gold-tone permanent filter avoids the ongoing cost and waste of paper filters
Long production history behind this specific Cuisinart line gives it a proven reliability record
Fully programmable with adjustable auto shutoff for flexible schedules
limitations: Does not publish a brew temperature or carry SCA certification
Older design lacks the flat-bottom filter geometry of the Bonavita or Ninja

products.name: Keurig K-Compact Single Serve Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 cup sizes: 8, 10, and 12 ounces, 5-inch-wide compact footprint, Removable 36-ounce reservoir.
strengths: Fastest brew of any machine here at roughly 30 seconds
Smallest footprint in this guide, fits the narrowest counters
Zero cleanup beyond removing the used pod
limitations: No temperature control or strength setting
12-cup drip machines in this guide produce better coffee per dollar for households, not solo drinkers

products.name: Kalita Wave Pour-Over Coffee Dripper 185
products.blurb: Key specs: Flat-bottom design with three small holes, Wave-shaped filter for consistent flow, Brews 1 to 2 cups per session.
strengths: Flat-bottom geometry produces more even extraction than any electric drip machine in this guide
Wave filter's consistent flow forgives imprecise pour technique better than cone drippers
Stainless build survives drops that would break a ceramic dripper
limitations: Requires a separate gooseneck kettle for proper technique
Proprietary wave filters cost more per filter than standard cone filters
Manual method means no programmable timer for automatic morning brewing
features: Flat-bottom design with three small holes

products.name: Hamilton Beach 49933 2-Way Single Serve and 12-Cup Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup carafe side plus K-Cup-compatible single-serve side, Independent brewing on each side, Adjustable single-serve cup sizes.
strengths: Programmable timer on the carafe side is a genuine upgrade over the non-programmable 49350
Adjustable single-serve cup sizes add flexibility K-Cup-only machines lack
One machine covers both a full pot for guests and a single cup for daily use
limitations: Neither side publishes a specific brew temperature or carries SCA certification
Costs more than the simpler 49350 for incremental convenience
Single-serve side lacks strength adjustment found on dedicated Keurig machines
features: 12-cup carafe side plus K-Cup-compatible single-serve side
Programmable 24-hour timer on the carafe side

products.name: Keurig K-Express Single Serve Coffee Maker
strengths: Brews 8, 10 or 12 oz cups
Strong button for bolder coffee
42 oz reservoir means fewer refills
Simple, affordable entry to K-Cups
limitations: Pod costs add up over time
No temperature or iced settings
Plastic build

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
